name: Alpha Miner (Classic)
author: Promenade Team
description: van der Aalst's original 2004 discovery algorithm — the textbook starting point for process discovery, kept here mainly for teaching its own well-known limitations (no noise tolerance, no short loops, no duplicate labels). Heuristics Miner or Inductive Miner is the better default on a real, noisy log.

minFrequency.title: Min. directly-follows frequency
minFrequency.description: Edges below this count are dropped before the relations are derived.

maxActivities.title: Activity limit
maxActivities.description: Keeps only the most frequent activities. Alpha Miner is bounded to 64 and is not meaningful on hundreds.

citation.text: van der Aalst, W.M.P., Weijters, T., Maruster, L. (2004). Workflow Mining: Discovering Process Models from Event Logs. IEEE TKDE 16(9), 1128-1142.
